```plato

// A matrix stored as its non-zero entries only (coordinate-list form). Any
// position absent from Entries is zero. Storage is proportional to the entry
// count, so this is the representation for the large, mostly-empty systems
// that arise in finite-element and graph problems.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sparse_matrix)
type SparseMatrix
    implements IValue
{
    NumRows: Integer;
    NumColumns: Integer;
    Entries: Array<SparseMatrixEntry>;
}
```
